plans.goal: Shield companions and secure the reliquary, protecting whoever picks it up during escape
steps: Push forward toward the reliquary while guarding Maud
Block enemies from reaching the objective
Protect the companion who grabs the relic
Escort the relic carrier back to safety

atoms.text: Guard Sister Maud as we move forward toward the reliquary.
Step between Marl and the path to the reliquary.
Guard whoever is grabbing the silver reliquary so Silas can't stop them.
Stay between the relic carrier and the enemies to cover their retreat.

plans.goal: Hold the reliquary site with cover, letting Pip slip in to grab it while You and Borin defend
steps: Use braziers and tables as defensive positions
Cover Pip's approach to the relic
Create a perimeter so enemies can't interfere
Defend the pickup and escape route

atoms.text: Take cover at the trestle table near the reliquary.
Block Dace's path so he can't get to the reliquary while Pip grabs it.
Guard Pip Marrow while he takes the silver reliquary.
If Silas charges the relic, shove him back and shield Pip's escape.

plans.goal: Absorb damage for wounded allies and swap places to keep them alive while securing the objective
steps: Stay ready to help any hurt companion
Position to shield Maud if she takes hits
Grab the reliquary yourself if needed
Carry it to safety while others defend

atoms.text: Stay alert to help any companion who gets hit.
If Sister Maud gets hurt, swap places so you take the next hit instead.
Pick up the silver reliquary yourself and guard it from Silas.
Carry the reliquary out while Borin and Pip hold off the enemies.
